missing_fields: Absolute reagent solution volumes and NaHTe stock concentration are not reported.
No diameter-specific reflux duration or temperature value is given; one generalized recipe, four observed parent sample outcomes.
Aqueous parent morphology and direct unit-cell coordinates are not supplied for these Table 1 samples.
Bulk polymer composite routes/figures are explicitly excluded from this selected colloidal synthesis package.
